name: calls/prefill
doc: the prefill call's contract, the facts that do not depend on the depth: `prefill` 1, the value width and the decay the carry will serve, the call's length and streams, whether a state rides it, the dense-plane pin and the declared budget. It is composed only by the OWED descriptors (hardware/descriptors/owed): the prefill kernels are not built, so nothing here is in the full contract. The depth, the level widths and the sparse flags are a depth part's (calls/depth1 .. calls/depth4).

d_v.declared_by: docs/internals/decode/arms_gen.md#the-contract: the value widths FSLA accepts, 2 up to the widest arm; the prefill's carry serves them by the same padding seam (docs/internals/padding.md); the arms it serves are fixed by the launch function of docs/open-work.md row A-f

decay.declared_by: docs/internals/decode/arms_gen.md#the-contract: the recurrence either decays (1) or not (0); the prefill's decay arm is owed (docs/open-work.md row C-h)

prefill.declared_by: this part is the prefill call: the prefill fact is 1

tokens.declared_by: docs/open-work.md row A-h: the prefill launch function (row A-f: the carve, the window, the grid and the segment length) fixes this range when the carry is built; until then it is declared wide; the range is the widest a token index of the kernels holds (int32)

batch_heads.declared_by: docs/open-work.md row A-h: the prefill launch function (row A-f: the carve, the window, the grid and the segment length) fixes this range when the carry is built; until then it is declared wide; the range is declared as wide as decode's (docs/api.md#batch-heads)

stateful.declared_by: docs/api.md section 1: a prefill is stateless (None) or carries a state in and out; either is a lawful call

dense_plane.declared_by: docs/internals/state.md: 1 pins the state's dense plane, the bit-identity gate's backing (the former `paging=False`); either value is a lawful call

memory_budget.declared_by: docs/open-work.md row A-h: the prefill launch function (row A-f: the carve, the window, the grid and the segment length) fixes this range when the carry is built; until then it is declared wide; 0 declares no budget (one segment)
